lines.zh: 泥水漫过我的背脊，我慢慢往前挪。
lines.en: Mud water over my back, I inch forward.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫开浮萍，留一道浅痕。
lines.en: My tail parts the duckweed, leaving a thin line.

lines.zh: 我沿着芦苇根走，水只到腹部。
lines.en: I follow the reed roots, water to my belly.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥吸住爪子，我一步步拔。
lines.en: The swamp mire holds my claws; I pull each step free.

lines.zh: 岸边的泥坡正合适，我爬上去晒背。
lines.en: The bank suits me; I haul out to sun my back.

lines.zh: 水浑得看不见底，正好。
lines.en: The water is too murky to see bottom, perfect.

lines.zh: 有只青蛙跳开，我懒得追。
lines.en: A frog hops away; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 我压着水走，连波纹都不多。
lines.en: I glide low, barely raising a ripple.

lines.zh: 老树干横在水里，我从下面钻过。
lines.en: A fallen trunk blocks the water; I slide beneath.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片挂着水草，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Weed clings to my scales and drops along the way.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么大，边界得自己划。
lines.en: The marsh is vast; I draw my own borders.

lines.zh: 太阳把泥晒硬了，我换个水洼。
lines.en: The sun bakes the mud; I find another pool.

lines.zh: 我半沉在水里，只留眼睛在外。
lines.en: I float nearly submerged, only my eyes above.

lines.zh: 一动不动，虫子会自己落下来。
lines.en: Stay still and the insects come to me.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开一点，让风吹进去。
lines.en: I open my jaws a little and let the air in.

lines.zh: 岸上那只鹭站了很久，我也等。
lines.en: That heron has stood a long while; I wait too.

lines.zh: 沼泽的气味里有腐叶和铁锈。
lines.en: The marsh smells of rot and rusted iron.

lines.zh: 泥里的气泡一个个冒上来。
lines.en: Bubbles rise one by one from the mud.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在水下懒懒地摆。
lines.en: My tail sways lazily under the water.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我该挪到暖泥里。
lines.en: The sun has moved; I should find warmer mud.

lines.zh: 这片水洼归我，别的鳄都知道。
lines.en: This pool is mine, and the other gators know it.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，牙全露出来了。
lines.en: I yawn, and every tooth shows.

lines.zh: 你站在我的岸上，影子落进水里。
lines.en: You stand on my bank; your shadow falls in.

lines.zh: 我不动，你先动就输了。
lines.en: I don't move; if you move first, you lose.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进泥里了，听见没？
lines.en: Your boots are sinking in the mire, hear it?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里有东西发亮。
lines.en: I watch your hands; something glints there.

lines.zh: 沼泽很少有客，你算一个。
lines.en: The marsh gets few visitors; you count as one.

lines.zh: 你退后的话，我就不追。
lines.en: Step back and I won't follow.

lines.zh: 我看你像看一只大一点的青蛙。
lines.en: I look at you the way I look at a large frog.

lines.zh: 水面把我的眼睛映得很亮。
lines.en: The water makes my eyes shine.

lines.zh: 你最好别蹲下来洗手。
lines.en: I'd advise against kneeling to wash your hands.

lines.zh: 我认路过的味道，你的太新。
lines.en: I know the smells that pass here; yours is new.

lines.zh: 疼得我翻了个身，泥全搅起来了。
lines.en: Pain rolls me over and churns the mud.

lines.zh: 我的鳞裂了一道，血混进水里。
lines.en: A scale split, and blood mixes with the water.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，声音闷在喉咙里。
lines.en: I growl low, the sound stuck in my throat.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，别走。
lines.en: I'll remember that one; don't leave.

lines.zh: 我退进水里，伤口凉下来。
lines.en: I back into the water and the wound cools.

lines.zh: 你砍的是我的侧腹，不是要害。
lines.en: You cut my flank, not anything vital.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，泥水溅到岸上。
lines.en: I shake my head and swamp water sprays the bank.

lines.zh: 泥浆敷上伤口，血腥味淡了。
lines.en: Mud packs the wound and dulls the blood smell.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抽了一下地面。
lines.en: My tail slaps once against the ground.

lines.zh: 叫声惊起一群白鹭。
lines.en: My cry sends a flock of egrets up.

lines.zh: 生肉落水，我一口就能接住。
lines.en: Drop raw meat in the water and I'll catch it.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼还在跳，我看见了。
lines.en: The fish in your hand still flops; I see it.

lines.zh: 腐肉也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Rotten flesh will do; I'm not particular.

lines.zh: 别伸手喂我，手指也算肉。
lines.en: Don't hand-feed me; fingers count as meat.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔远点，我再过去。
lines.en: Toss it farther out, then I'll come.

lines.zh: 这块肉值得我挪一挪身子。
lines.en: That piece is worth shifting my bulk for.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，比沼泽的水腥得多。
lines.en: I smell it, far sharper than swamp water.

lines.zh: 食物放下，人退开三步。
lines.en: Leave the food and take three steps back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，不代表我温和。
lines.en: My slow turn is not gentleness.

lines.zh: 你若只带了一块，别指望我谢你。
lines.en: If you brought one piece, don't expect thanks.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，快挪开。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail, move.

lines.zh: 我这一身鳞比你的盾厚。
lines.en: These scales are thicker than your shield.

lines.zh: 别挡我下水的路。
lines.en: Don't block my way to the water.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，泥都溅我背上了。
lines.en: You crowd in and splash mud on my back.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞了你一下，算轻的。
lines.en: I bumped you with my shoulder; that was gentle.

lines.zh: 让开，我要翻到暖泥里去。
lines.en: Move, I'm turning onto the warm mud.

lines.zh: 你站得太靠边，会滑下来。
lines.en: You stand too near the edge; you'll slide in.

lines.zh: 我发怒前会先张嘴，注意看。
lines.en: I open my jaws before I snap; watch.

lines.zh: 芦苇丛窄，我过你就得过。
lines.en: The reeds are narrow; if I pass, you must.

lines.zh: 别从后面拍我，那是找死。
lines.en: Don't tap me from behind; that's how you die.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，沼泽里都是低吼。
lines.en: Warm spring water, and the marsh fills with low bellows.

lines.zh: 她在泥岸上挖了个窝，我守着。
lines.en: She dug a nest in the bank; I stand watch.

lines.zh: 我们并排晒背，谁也不动。
lines.en: We sun ourselves side by side, neither moving.

lines.zh: 小鳄破壳那天，水刚好涨起来。
lines.en: The day the hatchlings broke out, the water rose.

lines.zh: 我把嘴合上，在她面前不张。
lines.en: I keep my jaws shut when she's near.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么大，我们只划了一块。
lines.en: The marsh is vast; we claimed only a corner.

lines.zh: 她用尾巴碰我，我就跟着走。
lines.en: She taps me with her tail, and I follow.

lines.zh: 那群小的挤在我背上，像浮木。
lines.en: The little ones crowd my back like driftwood.

lines.zh: 吼声传过整片芦苇，她在答我。
lines.en: My bellow crosses the reeds; she answers.

lines.zh: 我们守窝，轮着下水。
lines.en: We guard the nest in turns, one always in water.

lines.zh: 有东西漂过来，我用嘴叼住。
lines.en: Something drifts by; I catch it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我把骨头拖回窝边。
lines.en: I drag the bone back beside the nest.

lines.zh: 这块肉掉进泥里，还是我的。
lines.en: This meat fell in the mud; still mine.

lines.zh: 我咬住那根木棍，甩了两下。
lines.en: I grip the stick and shake it twice.

lines.zh: 水面的东西，我从来不浪费。
lines.en: Nothing on the water goes to waste.

lines.zh: 有人掉了铁片，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Someone dropped iron; it glints badly.

lines.zh: 我把它压在泥下藏着。
lines.en: I press it under the mud to keep.

lines.zh: 这味道是活的，还会动。
lines.en: This thing smells alive, and it moves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去，把它拖进水底。
lines.en: I sink slowly and drag it under.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞着东西，别跟我说话。
lines.en: My mouth is full; don't talk to me.

lines.zh: 水里有东西在扑腾，搅乱了我的池子。
lines.en: Something thrashes in the water and fouls my pool.

lines.zh: 那只猪走进浅滩了，太近了。
lines.en: That pig has waded into the shallows, too near.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的水域，脚就别想干净。
lines.en: You stepped into my water; your feet won't stay clean.

lines.zh: 有只狐狸在扒我的窝。
lines.en: A fox is digging at my nest.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的鹿低头喝水，脖子正好。
lines.en: A deer drinks with its neck bent just right.

lines.zh: 谁在岸上敲木头？吵得我头疼。
lines.en: Who's knocking wood on the bank? My head aches.

lines.zh: 那只鸡在泥里刨，刨到我嘴边了。
lines.en: That chicken scratches the mud right at my jaws.

lines.zh: 有东西咬了我的尾巴，我转身。
lines.en: Something bit my tail; I turn.

lines.zh: 你举着剑站在水里，那我就先来。
lines.en: You stand in the water with a sword; I'll start.

lines.zh: 水面下的影子不是鱼。
lines.en: The shadow under the surface is no fish.

lines.zh: 这群青蛙跳得太散，我挑最近的。
lines.en: The frogs scatter; I take the nearest.

lines.zh: 我的池子被人占了，得教教规矩。
lines.en: My pool has been taken; time for a lesson.

lines.zh: 那边草丛在动，风没那么大。
lines.en: The reeds move, and the wind isn't that strong.

lines.zh: 有东西在捞我的泥，爪子很吵。
lines.en: Something paws at my mud with noisy claws.

lines.zh: 有东西踩塌了我窝边的泥。
lines.en: Something has caved in the mud around my nest.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水面上，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across the water, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，只留鼻尖。
lines.en: I sink until only my snout shows.

lines.zh: 三步，再近三步就够了。
lines.en: Three steps, three more is enough.

lines.zh: 我把身子摆成一条直线。
lines.en: I line my body up straight.

lines.zh: 水流会带走我的味道。
lines.en: The current carries my scent away.

lines.zh: 它的影子在水面晃，我的心跳很慢。
lines.en: Its shadow wavers on the surface; my heart is slow.

lines.zh: 尾巴先绷紧，然后才是嘴。
lines.en: The tail coils first; the jaws come after.

lines.zh: 我等它低头，低头就看不见我。
lines.en: I wait for it to look down, then it can't see me.

lines.zh: 泥底很软，扑出去没有声音。
lines.en: The bottom is soft; my lunge makes no sound.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，我往前挪半寸。
lines.en: It backs off one step; I gain half an inch.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，沼泽里没人眨眼。
lines.en: I don't blink; nothing in the marsh blinks.

lines.zh: 距离够了，牙已经张开。
lines.en: Close enough; the jaws are already open.

lines.zh: 它回头看岸，这就是我的时机。
lines.en: It glances at the bank, and that's my moment.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸压到最轻。
lines.en: I press my breathing down to nothing.

lines.zh: 再等一息，就一息。
lines.en: One more breath of patience, just one.

lines.zh: 我绕到下游，从你背后靠过去。
lines.en: I slip downstream and come up behind you.

lines.zh: 我半沉在水里，只让眼睛露着。
lines.en: I sink to my eyes and nothing else shows.

lines.zh: 你踩着浅水走，水花太大。
lines.en: You wade the shallows and splash far too much.

lines.zh: 我等你走到泥最软的那块。
lines.en: I wait until you reach the softest patch of mud.

lines.zh: 尾巴在水下慢慢摆，调方向。
lines.en: My tail swings slowly underwater, setting my angle.

lines.zh: 你停住了，我也停住，看谁先动。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, and we see who moves first.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，然后往水里滚。
lines.en: I bite down and roll for the water.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，把它扫进泥里。
lines.en: My tail sweeps it flat into the mud.

lines.zh: 牙合上的声音像折断树枝。
lines.en: My jaws close like a snapping branch.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，等它不再挣扎。
lines.en: I hold on until it stops struggling.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，我的牙留下四道口。
lines.en: It tore free, and my teeth left four lines.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进深水，那里由我说话。
lines.en: I drag it to deep water, where I decide.

lines.zh: 这一口冲着腿，先让它跑不动。
lines.en: I go for the legs first, so it can't run.

lines.zh: 我翻身，把整个身子压上去。
lines.en: I roll and put my whole weight on it.

lines.zh: 泥浆溅得老高，我不管。
lines.en: Mud sprays high; I don't care.

lines.zh: 它砍在我背上，鳞片替我挡了。
lines.en: Its blade hits my back; the scales take it.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的武器，甩到岸上。
lines.en: I bite its weapon and fling it ashore.

lines.zh: 我不追，等它自己回来。
lines.en: I don't chase; I let it come back.

lines.zh: 嘴松开一下，再咬更深的。
lines.en: I loosen once, then bite deeper.

lines.zh: 沼泽安静下来，只剩我的呼吸。
lines.en: The marsh goes quiet; only my breathing remains.

lines.zh: 牙咬进肩，我甩头把它撕开。
lines.en: My teeth sink into a shoulder and I shake it open.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住脚踝，往深水里拖。
lines.en: I clamp onto an ankle and drag it into deep water.

lines.zh: 它挡住了嘴，我就用尾巴。
lines.en: It blocks my jaws, so I use my tail instead.

lines.zh: 骨头在我齿间响了一声。
lines.en: Bone clicks once between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我松开，退开一尺，再来。
lines.en: I let go, back off a foot, and come again.

lines.zh: 血味让沼泽更安静了。
lines.en: The smell of blood makes the swamp quieter still.

lines.zh: 我从泥里钻出来，背上全是水草。
lines.en: I rise from the mud with weed on my back.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽还没有主人，现在有了。
lines.en: This marsh had no master; now it does.

lines.zh: 水刚好漫到我的眼睛。
lines.en: The water comes right up to my eyes.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，先试了试风向。
lines.en: I open my jaws and taste the wind.

lines.zh: 芦苇丛里多了一个影子。
lines.en: One more shadow among the reeds.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬上岸，泥从背上滑落。
lines.en: I haul onto the bank, mud sliding off.

lines.zh: 这里有青蛙，有鱼，够我住下。
lines.en: Frogs and fish here; enough to settle.

lines.zh: 鳞片还是湿的，得先晒干。
lines.en: My scales are still wet; I need the sun.

lines.zh: 我选了一处水草最密的地方。
lines.en: I choose the thickest patch of weed.

lines.zh: 远处有鳄在叫，我回了一声。
lines.en: A gator calls far off; I answer.

lines.zh: 泥底的凉意顺着腹部上来。
lines.en: The cool of the bottom climbs my belly.

lines.zh: 这片水域，从今天起算我的。
lines.en: These waters are mine from today.

lines.zh: 火烫进鳞缝里，我往水里扑。
lines.en: Fire bites between my scales; I dive for water.

lines.zh: 从泥坡上滑下来，摔得背疼。
lines.en: I slid down the bank and landed on my back.

lines.zh: 水太深了，我翻不过身来。
lines.en: The water is too deep; I can't right myself.

lines.zh: 那声炸响把沼泽都震哑了。
lines.en: The blast stunned the whole marsh silent.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我背上的硬鳞。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the hard scales of my back.

lines.zh: 这股冷意不是沼泽该有的。
lines.en: This cold isn't something the marsh makes.

lines.zh: 几天没吃到活物，肚子贴地。
lines.en: Days without prey; my belly drags the mud.

lines.zh: 雷劈在枯树上，我整条身子发麻。
lines.en: Lightning split a dead tree; my whole body tingles.

lines.zh: 我从水面掉下去，下面是空的。
lines.en: I fell past the water into nothing.
